recipes.title: Spaghetti Aglio e Olio
recipes.description: Simple pasta with garlic, olive oil, chili flakes and parsley.
steps: Cook spaghetti until al dente.
Sauté garlic in olive oil until fragrant, add chili flakes.
Toss pasta with garlic oil and parsley, season and serve.

recipes.title: Lemon Garlic Salmon
recipes.description: Roasted salmon with lemon and garlic served with vegetables.
steps: Preheat oven to 200°C/400°F.
Place salmon and broccoli on a baking tray; drizzle with oil, lemon, garlic, salt and pepper.
Bake 12-18 minutes until salmon is cooked through.

recipes.title: Chicken Stir-Fry
recipes.description: Quick stir-fry with chicken and mixed vegetables in a savory sauce.
steps: Heat oil in a wok and stir-fry chicken until cooked through.
Add vegetables and ginger, stir-fry until tender-crisp.
Add soy sauce and sesame oil, toss to combine, and serve over rice.

recipes.title: Beef Tacos
recipes.description: Seasoned ground beef served in taco shells with fresh toppings.
steps: Cook beef with taco seasoning until browned.
Fill taco shells with beef and top with lettuce, tomatoes, salsa, and cheese.

recipes.title: Baked Pesto Chicken
recipes.description: Chicken breasts topped with pesto and baked with tomatoes and mozzarella.
steps: Preheat oven to 200°C/400°F.
Place chicken in a baking dish, spread pesto over each, add tomatoes and mozzarella.
Bake 20-25 minutes until chicken is cooked through.

recipes.title: Tomato Basil Soup
recipes.description: Comforting pureed tomato soup brightened with fresh basil.
steps: Sauté onion and garlic in oil until soft.
Add tomatoes and broth, simmer 15 minutes.
Blend until smooth, stir in basil, season, and serve.

recipes.title: Chicken Noodle Soup
recipes.description: Classic, soothing soup with chicken, vegetables, and noodles.
steps: Sauté onion, carrots, and celery until softened.
Add stock and bring to a boil, add noodles and chicken, simmer until noodles are tender.
Season and serve hot.

recipes.title: Lentil Soup
recipes.description: Nutritious lentil soup flavored with garlic, cumin, and vegetables.
steps: Sauté onion, carrot, and garlic in olive oil until soft.
Add lentils, broth, and cumin; simmer until lentils are tender (20–25 minutes).
Season and serve.

recipes.title: Minestrone
recipes.description: Hearty vegetable soup with beans and small pasta, a one-pot meal.
steps: Sauté onion, carrot, and celery in oil until tender.
Add remaining vegetables, tomatoes, broth, and pasta; simmer until pasta is cooked.
Season and serve.

recipes.title: Garlic Roasted Potatoes
recipes.description: Crispy roasted potatoes with garlic and herbs.
steps: Preheat oven to 200°C/400°F.
Toss potatoes with oil, garlic, rosemary, salt and pepper.
Roast until golden and crisp, about 30–35 minutes, stirring once.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Fries
recipes.description: Oven-baked sweet potato fries seasoned with smoked paprika.
ingredients: 2 medium sweet potatoes, cut into fries
steps: Preheat oven to 220°C/425°F.
Toss fries with oil, paprika, and salt.
Bake on a single layer for 20–25 minutes, flipping once, until crisp.

recipes.title: Honey Soy Green Beans
recipes.description: Green beans sautéed in a sweet and savory honey-soy glaze.
steps: Blanch green beans until bright green and slightly tender.
Sauté garlic in sesame oil, add beans, soy sauce and honey; toss to coat.

recipes.title: Air Fryer Brussels Sprouts
recipes.description: Crispy air-fried brussels sprouts with a tangy balsamic finish.
steps: Toss sprouts with oil, salt, and pepper.
Air fry at 200°C/400°F for 12–15 minutes until crispy, shaking halfway.
Drizzle balsamic and serve.

recipes.title: Garlic Butter Shrimp
recipes.description: Quick sautéed shrimp in garlic butter and lemon.
steps: Melt butter in a skillet, add garlic and cook briefly.
Add shrimp and cook 2–3 minutes per side until opaque.
Stir in lemon and parsley and serve immediately.

recipes.title: Shrimp Tacos
recipes.description: Spiced shrimp in warm tortillas topped with cabbage slaw and lime.
steps: Toss shrimp with chili powder and salt then cook in oil until done.
Mix cabbage with mayo and lime for slaw.
Assemble tacos with shrimp and slaw, serve with lime wedges.

recipes.title: Beef Tacos Bowl
recipes.description: All the taco flavors served over rice for an easy bowl meal.
steps: Cook beef with taco seasoning until browned.
Assemble bowls with rice, beans, corn, beef, salsa and avocado.

recipes.title: Chicken Quesadilla
recipes.description: Cheesy tortilla filled with cooked chicken and veggies, toasted until golden.
steps: Place filling on half of a tortilla, fold and cook on a skillet until cheese melts and tortilla is golden.
Slice into wedges and serve with salsa.

recipes.title: Chicken Fried Rice
recipes.description: Stir-fried rice with chicken, egg, and vegetables using leftover rice.
steps: Scramble eggs in a wok and set aside.
Stir-fry vegetables in oil, add rice and chicken, and toss with soy sauce.
Fold in scrambled eggs and serve hot.

recipes.title: Egg Fried Rice
recipes.description: Simple fried rice with eggs and vegetables for a quick meal.
steps: Heat oil, scramble eggs and set aside.
Stir-fry veggies, add rice and soy sauce, then fold in eggs and serve.
